messages.summary:
## Objective
- Deliver OmmyCut native Windows desktop source/update packages with approved features only.
- Replace rejected procedural SFX with a huge online-sourced CC0 library, confidence-gated mood matching, and a strong first-3-second viewer hook.

## Requirements
- OmmyCut-only visible branding; no visible “ClipKontrast” name/logo.
- Keep hidden compatibility identifiers unchanged: `CLIPKONTRAST_*`, `clipkontrast.db`, `clipkontrast.log`, hidden storage keys.
- Native Windows WebView2/pywebview app; install target `C:\ommycut`; app searchable/openable as **OmmyCut**.
- Remove Paid campaigns, Report a problem, Earn, campaign/advertisement items.
- Home action button must be **Github** with GitHub logo linking `https://github.com/cyzowebdev/ommycut.git`.
- Phone access: canonical state at `C:\ommycut\data\remote.json`, PIN support, `246810` accepted, URL shown, stays ON across restarts.
- Phone Access tab includes QR for `https://linktr.ee/ommycut` and text “Scan with your phone for phone access.”
- Preserve Live clipping, creator tag, 4 PNG previews, `/IShowSpeed`, Cut silences, Auto zoom, manual Check for update.
- Check for update must stay manual; no automatic update checks.
- Storage cleanup: manual delete by master video and auto-delete schedule Off/2/5/7 days; deleted items go to Windows Recycle Bin.
- Update zips named `OmmyCut-GitHub-<version>.zip`, placed in `C:\Users\soham\release\update`, uploaded to GitHub repo root on `main`.
- Separate **Edit video** tab must remain removed.
- User can download/install whatever is needed for SFX.
- SFX must come from online libraries, be huge/varied, apply only when mood is confidently detected, and never fire randomly.
- User said current mood understanding is “very bad”; fix it.
- Add “any crazy effect” to hook viewers in the first 3 seconds.
- UI must be “SUPERB” and match the whole aesthetic; user gets one toggle and the mechanism works by itself.

## Decisions
- Keep hidden compatibility identifiers unchanged; only visible branding changed.
- Native window dependencies: `pywebview==6.2.1`, `setuptools==80.9.0`, `proxy_tools==0.1.0` installed with `--no-build-isolation`.
- Installer handles repo containing `OmmyCut-GitHub.zip` instead of extracted `app/`.
- Updater stages only `app/`; preserves runtime/user data and uses `selfupdate._quit(selfupdate.RESTART_CODE)`.
- Separate Edit video feature was added then rejected; removed in v2026.11.23.14 and must stay removed.
- Previous procedural oscillator/noise SFX and keyword mood detector are rejected/superseded.
- Rebuild SFX around CC0 online library assets bundled offline, with provenance/credits metadata.
- Keep one toggle in normal clip editor and live editor; no separate edit feature.
- For local testing, installed `C:\ommycut\app` code synced to v14 code, but `C:\ommycut\app\VERSION` left `2026.11.23.12` so Check for update still offers v14.

## Work State
### Completed
- OmmyCut branding, native WebView2 window, install target `C:\ommycut`, Desktop/Start menu shortcuts.
- Removed Paid campaigns, Report a problem, Earn, campaign/advertisement items from visible app.
- Replaced Home action with **Github** button + GitHub logo linking `https://github.com/cyzowebdev/ommycut.git`.
- Phone access, PIN behavior, phone URL, `246810`, persistent ON state, QR to `https://linktr.ee/ommycut`.
- Live clipping, creator tag, 4 PNG previews, `/IShowSpeed`, Cut silences, Auto zoom, manual update.
- Installer auto-unpack logic and requirements handling fixed.
- YouTube “The page needs to be reloaded” handling improved with alternate clients and friendly message.
- Updater bug fixed: valid zip containing `app/studio/server.py` no longer rejected as missing app folder.
- Speech model permission crash and `FileExistsError: [WinError 183]` fixed in `fetch_model.py`.
- YouTube upload quota message improved to “YouTube says this account has reached its upload limit for now. Wait a while or use another account.”
- Storage cleanup added and “Loading…” bug fixed via `loadCleanup()`.
- Generated logo PNGs: `C:\Users\soham\release\ommycut-logo-symbol.png`, `ommycut-logo-black.png`, `ommycut-logo-white.png`.
- Removed separate Edit video feature from `index.html`, `server.py`, and deleted `app/studio/edit.py`.
- Built v2026.11.23.14 package with procedural SFX: `C:\Users\soham\release\update\OmmyCut-GitHub-2026.11.23.14.zip`, SHA256 `879FEED7198E7CCCBCF344172C3DB67BD7F5B11FBFA5D2A301F0B636124A7077`; stale/superseded because SFX was rejected.
- Refreshed `C:\Users\soham\release\OmmyCut-GitHub.zip` with same SHA256 as v14 numbered zip.
- Verified v14 with `compileall`, JS syntax check via `deno.exe`, and real render with SFX on/off audio peaks `-2.3 dB` vs `-3.7 dB`.
- Identified CC0 online sources: Kenney audio packs, `https://github.com/Mcamento8/open-game-sfx-index`, `https://github.com/wyzowl/sfx-kit`, `https://github.com/Daarko/sparkstream-sounds`, `https://github.com/GeorgeQLe/assets-sfx-combat`, `https://github.com/smartpage/strongerfx-mcp`.
- Downloaded `C:\Users\soham\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\sfx-download\sparkstream-sounds.zip` size `35268592` and `assets-sfx-combat.zip` size `7673719`.
- Inspected current integration:
  - `app/studio/sfx.py`: procedural sine/noise synth, weak keyword classifier, fallback punch.
  - `app/studio/render.py` lines 594-604: SFX planning/write/mix hook.
  - `app/studio/live.py` line 589: live clips pass `sfx=self.settings.get("sfx", True)`.
  - `app/web/index.html`: `sfxCard(...)` toggle cards at lines 2302, 2334, 3293.

### Active
- Finish CC0 asset acquisition/extraction; `open-game-sfx-index.zip` and `sfx-kit.zip` downloads were still running in background.
- Choose/copy a large curated offline SFX set into the app asset folder with license/provenance metadata.
- Replace `app/studio/sfx.py` with library-backed SFX selection plus stricter situation-aware mood classification.
- Add first-3-second hook: strong early audio sting + visual/temporal punch that does not break captions/tag/tighten/live rendering.
- Update SFX toggle copy from “Punchy sound effects” to mood-matched SFX + 3s hook while keeping one-toggle UI.
- Verify normal clip composer, live composer, and re-edit dialog with the rebuilt mechanism.
- Rebuild version v2026.11.23.15 packages after rework.

### Blocked
- GitHub browser session not signed in; automated upload/push failed earlier.
- No confirmed commit/push/merge/upload to `https://github.com/cyzowebdev/ommycut.git`; user has been uploading manually.
- Latest `.14` update upload not confirmed.

## Next Move
1. Finish/extract downloaded CC0 archives in `C:\Users\soham\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\sfx-download`; bundle selected assets offline under the app with `SFX-CREDITS.md`.
2. Replace `app/studio/sfx.py`: real sample playback, mood/situation confidence gates, transcript semantics, punctuation, loudness dynamics, timing, varied categories, no random/fallback placement.
3. Add a dedicated first-3-second hook in `render.py`/`sfx.py`: strong early sting plus visual/temporal punch compatible with captions/tag/tighten/live.
4. Update `index.html` SFX cards/copy and preserve the single toggle in normal clip editor, live composer, and re-edit dialog.
5. Test multiple real clips/transcripts; confirm SFX fires only for high-confidence matched moods and hook always lands in first 3 seconds.
6. Bump `app\VERSION` to `2026.11.23.15`, rebuild `C:\Users\soham\release\update\OmmyCut-GitHub-2026.11.23.15.zip`, refresh `C:\Users\soham\release\OmmyCut-GitHub.zip` and `UPLOAD-THESE.txt`, provide SHA256 and release notes.

## Relevant Files
- `C:\Users\soham\release\ommycut-repo\app\studio\sfx.py`: rejected procedural SFX/mood module to replace.
- `C:\Users\soham\release\ommycut-repo\app\studio\render.py`: render pipeline and SFX mix hook.
- `C:\Users\soham\release\ommycut-repo\app\web\index.html`: UI, SFX toggle cards, clip editor, live composer, theme/CSS.
- `C:\Users\soham\release\ommycut-repo\app\studio\jobs.py`: clip options/defaults, `clean_options`, render requests.
- `C:\Users\soham\release\ommycut-repo\app\studio\live.py`: live clip settings/render; passes `sfx`.
- `C:\Users\soham\release\ommycut-repo\app\studio\creators.py`: creator look defaults including `sfx`.
- `C:\Users\soham\release\ommycut-repo\app\studio\server.py`: API routes; edit endpoints removed.
- `C:\Users\soham\release\ommycut-repo\app\studio\ommy_update.py`: manual update discovery/staging.
- `C:\Users\soham\release\ommycut-repo\app\studio\media.py`: FFmpeg/download helpers.
- `C:\Users\soham\release\ommycut-repo\app\VERSION`: source version currently `2026.11.23.14`.
- `C:\Users\soham\release\update`: numbered update zips.
- `C:\Users\soham\release\OmmyCut-GitHub.zip`: plain full source package used by installer.
- `C:\Users\soham\release\UPLOAD-THESE.txt`: upload list, hashes, release notes.
- `C:\ommycut\app`: installed test copy; code synced to v14, VERSION intentionally left `2026.11.23.12`.
- `C:\Users\soham\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\sfx-download`: downloaded CC0 SFX archives.

## Important Context
- Current source version is `2026.11.23.14`; v14 SFX was rejected and is stale relative to latest request.
- v14 update zip SHA256: `879FEED7198E7CCCBCF344172C3DB67BD7F5B11FBFA5D2A301F0B636124A7077`.
- `OmmyCut-Installer.exe` SHA256: `97FCF303B4E0836402748032896E092D838F41190A7AC29D4B8C15A19788C65C`.
- Upload files to GitHub repo root on `main`: `OmmyCut-GitHub.zip`, newest numbered update zip, `OmmyCut-Installer.exe`, `README.md`.
- Update zip creation excludes `data`, `models`, `users`, `tmp`, `logs`, `window`, `__pycache__`, `.exe`, `.sed`, `.pyc`, `remote.json`, `clipkontrast.db`, `posts.json`.
- Installer needs `setuptools==80.9.0`, then `proxy_tools==0.1.0` with `--no-build-isolation`, then `pywebview==6.2.1`.
- Phone access QR image lives at `app\web\brand\phone-access-qr.png`.
- Official Kenney direct ZIP URLs from community `SOURCES.md` returned HTML pages (~14–15KB), and `https://kenney.nl/download-link/6173736574732f696d706163742d736f756e6473` returned `403`; use verified GitHub CC0 archives instead.
- `git` is unavailable: `git : The term 'git' is not recognized as the name of a cmdlet, function, script file, or operable program.` Use codeload ZIP downloads with `Invoke-WebRequest`.
- CC0 candidates: `open-game-sfx-index` 1451 sounds with `index.json`/`ATTRIBUTION.md`; `sfx-kit` 320 sounds with `sounds.json`/`analysis.json`; `sparkstream-sounds` 521 Kenney WAVs with `manifest.json`/`credits/`; `assets-sfx-combat` 255 Kenney assets with `manifest.json`/`LICENSES/`.
- Existing SFX UI text: “Punchy sound effects” / “Listens for jokes, rage, wins and big hits, then drops the right sound by itself.”
- Current renderer only adds SFX when `clip.get("sfx")` is truthy; hook must remain non-fatal and preserve video stream where possible.
- User is frustrated; prioritize direct implementation, strong visible result, and final package over explanation.

"""Build the OmmyCut v15 source packages (plain installer zip + numbered update zip)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import os
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

SRC = Path(r"C:\Users\soham\release\ommycut-repo")
OUT_DIR = Path(r"C:\Users\soham\release\update")
VERSION = (SRC / "app" / "VERSION").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
PLAIN = Path(r"C:\Users\soham\release\OmmyCut-GitHub.zip")
NUMBERED = OUT_DIR / f"OmmyCut-GitHub-{VERSION}.zip"

INCLUDE_TOP = {
    ".gitignore", "FFMPEG-LICENSE.txt", "OmmyCut.cmd", "ommycut.ico",
    "README.md", "requirements.txt", "app", "installer",
}
EXCLUDE_DIRS = {"data", "models", "users", "tmp", "logs", "window", "__pycache__", ".git", ".github"}
EXCLUDE_NAMES = {"remote.json", "clipkontrast.db", "posts.json", "Thumbs.db", ".DS_Store"}
EXCLUDE_SUFFIXES = {".pyc", ".sed", ".exe"}


def keep(rel: Path) -> bool:
    parts = rel.parts
    if not parts or parts[0] not in INCLUDE_TOP:
        return False
    if any(p in EXCLUDE_DIRS for p in parts[:-1]):
        return False
    name = parts[-1]
    if name in EXCLUDE_NAMES or name.lower().endswith(tuple(EXCLUDE_SUFFIXES)):
        return False
    return True


def build(dest: Path) -> None:
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tmp = dest.with_suffix(dest.suffix + ".tmp")
    files = sorted((p for p in SRC.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and keep(p.relative_to(SRC))),
                   key=lambda p: p.relative_to(SRC).as_posix().lower())
    with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=6, allowZip64=True) as z:
        for p in files:
            rel = p.relative_to(SRC).as_posix()
            info = zipfile.ZipInfo(rel, date_time=(2026, 11, 24, 0, 0, 0))
            info.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
            info.external_attr = (0o100644 & 0xFFFF) << 16
            z.writestr(info, p.read_bytes())
    os.replace(tmp, dest)


def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest().upper()


def main() -> None:
    for dest in (PLAIN, NUMBERED):
        build(dest)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(dest) as z:
            names = z.namelist()
            sounds = [n for n in names if n.startswith("app/assets/sfx/library/")]
            manifest = "app/assets/sfx/sounds.json" in names
            credits = "app/assets/sfx/SFX-CREDITS.md" in names
            version = z.read("app/VERSION").decode("utf-8").strip()
            assert version == VERSION, (dest, version)
            assert len(sounds) == 1684, (dest, len(sounds))
            assert manifest and credits, (dest, manifest, credits)
            assert "app/studio/sfx.py" in names and "app/web/index.html" in names
            assert not any("__pycache__" in n or n.endswith(".pyc") for n in names)
            print(f"{dest.name}: {len(names)} entries, {len(sounds)} sounds, {dest.stat().st_size} bytes")
        print("  SHA256", sha256(dest))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

  the live composer and the per-clip re-edit dialog. No new controls.

  voice duck at the hook, so it works with every layout, with Cut silences on
  or off, and for live clips. A clip with no audio still gets the hook track.

  clip editor and live options.

  CLIPKONTRAST_* environment variables, clipkontrast.db, clipkontrast.log and
  hidden storage keys are unchanged.
